name: io.github.arnienemeth/geo-explorer-mcp
description: Country facts, administrative boundaries and regional statistics as structured data, for building interactive geography.

environmentVariables.name: RESTCOUNTRIES_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free API key from https://restcountries.com/sign-up, used for country facts.

environmentVariables.name: GEO_EXPLORER_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: A contact URL or email placed in the User-Agent sent to Wikidata. Wikimedia rejects requests without one.
